messages:
Priya (PM): Quick async check-in for Q2 milestone slice — please post a single-line update for your owned milestone using this template: Shipped/Slipped; brief cause; immediate next action; blockers/deps (if any). Example: Shipped; canary finished; cut release; no deps. Please do by EOD today.
Evan (Eng): Shipped; inference cache feature landed last week; rollout at 20% and stable; next: expand to 60% tomorrow; dep: need load-testing from SRE.
Sam (SRE): Noted Evan — I can run the perf sweep. Slipped (was planning wider roll); reason: test harness flaky with long-tail latencies; next: triage harness failures today; blocker: need a small config change from EngInfra.
Jules (EngInfra): Slipped; mounting issue with autoscaler policy on dedicated pools; cause: edge case with pod preemption + GPU reclaim; next: patch queued (#PR 4821) to env-config; blocker: needs one-hour maintenance window to deploy patch.
Marta (ML): Shipped; model v2.1 quantized variant validated; quality within 0.5% of baseline; next: attach model to dedicated pool for e2e smoke; dep: EngInfra patch for quantized runtime scheduling (tracking with Jules).
Kris (Design): Shipped; UX tweaks for the rollout banner and cost-estimate tooltip merged; next: coordinate copy review with PMs; no blockers.
deploy-bot: deploy: patch to autoscaler-config v1.12 scheduled for 2024-04-25 02:00 UTC (maintenance window requested by @Jules).
Priya (PM): Quick note — Evan/Marta, if EngInfra needs a maintenance window, please propose times; product OKR owners prefer low-traffic slot.
Evan (Eng): A couple of quick asks: 1) Sam, can you prioritize the perf sweep for 3pm PT? 2) @Jules once env patch is live I will re-run canary to 60%; PR: #4799 references quantized runtime.
Sam (SRE): 3pm PT works. I need the harness logs forwarded (s3 link) — Evan can you upload? Also adding a short checklist: run perf-sweep -> sanity-slowpath -> traffic-profile ramp.
Evan (Eng): Uploaded logs: s3://redwood-infer-ci/harness/1715002468/trace.tar.gz. Thanks.
Jules (EngInfra): Maintenance window ack. I can do 02:00 UTC or 22:00 UTC — prefer 02:00. After patch: run smoke -> update node-config map -> restart agent. I will post exact rollback steps in the ops runbook.
Marta (ML): FYI after patch we should run the model-quality probe against Canary (50k tokens) before ramp. I can trigger that as soon as canary is bumped.
Kris (Design): Small follow-up — the rollout banner needs a short copy tweak: change "Rolling out to users" -> "Gradual rollout under monitoring". Priya ok to approve?
Priya (PM): Approved. Kris, you can patch copy. Also action: I will consolidate these single-line updates into the milestone doc and flag a short sync if we still have blockers after the maintenance window.
Evan (Eng): One more: code-review pings — PR #4799 and #4821 need quick reviews. Assigning @Marta and @Sam respectively.
Marta (ML): Reviewing #4799 now, should be done within 2 hours.
Sam (SRE): I will review #4821 after the harness triage.
Priya (PM): Thanks all. I'll post a 1-paragraph summary after the maintenance window and mark owners for follow-ups. If anything slips further, ping this thread with 'Escalate' prefix.
Evan (Eng): Escalate: if perf-sweep shows >3x tail latency we may need to rollback the canary; will post findings.
Sam (SRE): Update (post-sweep): saw two flaky nodes causing 95p spikes; isolating now, will report remediation ETA within 45m.
Jules (EngInfra): Patch deployed to staging; smoke passed. Scheduling prod deploy for 02:00 UTC as requested. Rollback target: revert config map and restart agent (documented).
Marta (ML): Quality probe queued to run once canary hits 50%.
Priya (PM): Final for now — summary: Evan/Marta shipped model and cache; Autoscaler patch required and scheduled; SRE found node flakiness being remediated; next steps: prod deploy at 02:00 UTC, post-deploy canary bump -> quality probe -> ramp. Owners: Evan (canary bump), Jules (prod deploy), Sam (harness/perf), Marta (quality probe), Kris (banner copy). Thanks. :tada:
